_method.authored: 2026-08-02, before any of these were run against the index
_method.rule: A query that misses STAYS in this file, unedited. Rewording queries until they pass overfits to a moving test set and destroys the measurement.
_method.contamination_disclosure: Phases 0-3 of this build exposed parts of the grandMA2 corpus: the chapter list, several search results with heading paths, and sample pages 95/211/500/1041/1500. Queries written purely from lighting-operator domain knowledge are marked blind:true. Queries informed by something seen earlier in this session are marked blind:false and are reported separately, so they cannot inflate the blind hit rate.
_method.expect_semantics: For grandMA2, 'expect' is a section prefix matched by the same component-wise subtree rule as index terms (section 21 covers 21.3, never 210). For QLC+, which is unnumbered, 'expect' is a case-insensitive substring of heading_path.

categories.heading-term: an exact technical term that appears in a heading
categories.body-term: a term that appears only in body text
categories.conceptual-slang: operator vocabulary the manual does not use; BM25 is weakest here and this is where the index-term boost has to earn its place
categories.figure-dominated: the answer is in a screenshot or diagram, not in the extracted text
categories.spans-boundary: the answer plainly continues past a chunk boundary
categories.cross-doc: run unscoped to observe cross-document IDF behaviour
